field_principles.adaptation_curve: Per-family (best-adaptive - static) gain as families stream in -- shows whether adaptation compounds (the continuous-self-learning signature) or is flat.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. An adaptive gain AND a now-bug-free static-is-the-ceiling null are BOTH COMPLETE -- both valid self-learning findings (the bug-free null retires the ask).
field_principles.model_specs: The Tier-1 reweighting rule + the FIXED Tier-2 memory rule + the Tier-2 retrieval rule + the combined family stream; required methodology.
field_principles.online_adaptation_helps: BARE bool: true iff the best adaptive selector (online / tier2-memory / tier2-retrieval) exceeds static AND the (adaptive-static) CI95 excludes 0 with power -- the self-learning value verdict the .396 tier-2 bug could not settle.
field_principles.online_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the online-reweighted selector's delta -- the Tier-1 self-learning result.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; the family stream order + reweighting reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the folds + reweighting + memory + retrieval trace; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.static_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the static set-encoder's held-out-family delta -- the no-adaptation baseline.
field_principles.tier2_memory_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the FIXED constraint-memory selector's delta -- MUST differ from static (the .396 no-op bug is fixed).
field_principles.tier2_not_noop: BARE bool: true iff at least one tier-2 arm differs from static on >=1 family -- the explicit guard against repeating the .396 tautology (a tier-2 arm identical to static is a bug, not a finding).
field_principles.tier2_retrieval_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the retrieval-augmented selector's delta -- the Decocted-style no-weight-mutation arm.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- learned selector with online weight updates + a pattern cache + retrieval, no demo execution and no fine-tuning.

set_encoder_config.architecture_note: Permutation-equivariant DeepSets scorer: per-candidate MLP embedding, mean/max pooled full-set context, and per-candidate logits conditioned on that context.
set_encoder_config.cross_candidate_conditioning: vote priors, self-consistency margins, modal-grid agreement, duplicate counts, shape/palette family indicators, and DeepSets mean/max latent pooling over all candidates
set_encoder_config.imbalance_loss: class_weighted_bce_with_positive_task_minibatches; negative-only tasks are scored held-out but do not form training minibatches
set_encoder_config.set_attention_reference: CPU-fast fallback for the Set-LLM set-attention-mask / Set-Encoder cross-candidate attention lever; still consumes the full candidate set without positional features.

tier1_online_reweighting_rule.current_family_feedback: not used until after every task in that family is scored

tier2_memory_rule.cache: per-family ranked selector-arm pattern with per-arm precision context
tier2_memory_rule.current_family_feedback: cached only after every task in that family is scored
tier2_memory_rule.hardware_path: CPU/system-memory cache lookup, FPGA-friendly pattern match
tier2_memory_rule.lookup: reuse nearest already-seen family's cached ranked pattern
tier2_memory_rule.no_op_guard: tier2_not_noop requires memory or retrieval candidate differs from static

tier2_retrieval_rule.conditioning: average retrieved per-arm precision context, then select among cached candidate nominees
tier2_retrieval_rule.hardware_path: CPU/system-memory vector lookup, FPGA-friendly approximate nearest-neighbor path
tier2_retrieval_rule.retrieval: k=3 nearest seen-family contexts by feature profile distance
